clusters.mechanism: The new delivery guard wrongly refuses a resumable run when an interruption leaves the gate stage's recorded status non-succeeded, even though the cached gate evidence is valid and HEAD is unchanged.
If the resumed-delivery GitHub lookup throws before the guard runs, the draft-fallback path pushes lastVerifiedSha without the shared HEAD guard, so an amended HEAD can still be pushed.

The pending-merge exception trusts a merge commit based only on its parent SHAs (validateMerge), so an amended merge with the same parents but different content is accepted and delivered without audit or review.
